violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 165F
violations.observation: The water temperature in the manifold servicing the high temperature warewashing machine was below the minimum allowable level of 165F for a stationary rack single temperature machine. The thermostat read 145f.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanical operation the temperature of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 194F or less than 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine or for all other machines, 180F. CDI use 3 compartment sink to sanitize all dishes.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: dish machine not hot enough
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation System Cleaning
violations.observation: Intake and exhaust air ducts are not being cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent contamination by dust, dirt, and other materials. Hoods very dusty.
violations.corrective_action: Clean intake and exhaust air ducts at regularly intervals to prevent them from becoming sources of contamination. Have hoods cleaned and ensure they are working properly.
